scripts.build: mkdir -p ../dist/css ../dist/js ../dist/icon && sass --style compressed scss/custom.scss:../dist/css/bootstrap.min.css && cp node_modules/lz-string/libs/lz-string.min.js ../dist/js/lz-string.min.js && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js ../dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js && cp node_modules/jquery/dist/jquery.min.js ../dist/js/jquery.min.js && cp node_modules/jquery-validation/dist/jquery.validate.min.js ../dist/js/jquery.validate.min.js && cp node_modules/jquery-validation/dist/additional-methods.min.js ../dist/js/additional-methods.min.js && cp css/main.css ../dist/css/ && cp index.html ../dist/ && cp js/main.js ../dist/js/ && cp -r icon/* ../dist/icon/ && cp favicon.ico ../dist/ && cp robots.txt ../dist/ && cp sitemap.xml ../dist/ && cp ads.txt ../dist/ && cp 404.html ../dist/
scripts.build:full: npm run build && cp index.html ../dist/ && cp css/main.css ../dist/css/ && cp -r js/* ../dist/js/
